knowledge.title: lending overview
gaps: The remedy when a member at the five-loan limit attempts locker pickup is not established by the supplied material; only the prohibition on evading the limit that way is stated [cd729138-dd10-4c76-b209-d2b44a4d104b].

No time bound or escalation path is supplied for a damaged return awaiting a librarian's clearance, or for an item whose locker code revocation cannot be confirmed and which therefore remains reserved for staff review [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04].

Person-bound pickup codes are stated only in the deferred decision; no other supplied original states the code-binding rule, so its operational detail is not established [3b39abb6-997d-48d8-a11e-da7b2bf6e923].

The outcome of the next-quarter demand investigation and any reconsideration of automatic third renewals or transferable family pickup codes is not supplied; the deferred package is scoped to release 6 [3b39abb6-997d-48d8-a11e-da7b2bf6e923].

No supplied original establishes member notification behavior for hold assignment, hold cancellation, or lost-item confirmation [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04] [cd729138-dd10-4c76-b209-d2b44a4d104b].

Damage inspection is required before placing a returned item on a pickup shelf or in a locker, and a librarian clears damaged returns, but the supplied originals do not state who performs inspection or how clearance is recorded beyond the general operation-ID requirement [cd729138-dd10-4c76-b209-d2b44a4d104b] [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04] [922e733e-29b5-4bcd-b8db-38d8acd6b2d2].

knowledge.title: Holds and locker assignment
gaps: No supplied evidence establishes the channel or process for cancelling an assigned-but-uncollected hold; the evidence states only that cancellation requires locker service code revocation. [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04]

No supplied decision states the disposition of an already-assigned locker hold when the member is suspended; the proposed exception for suspended members to collect already-assigned locker holds was explicitly not approved. [3b39abb6-997d-48d8-a11e-da7b2bf6e923][922e733e-29b5-4bcd-b8db-38d8acd6b2d2]

No supplied evidence states a timeout or escalation path beyond the stated outcome of remaining reserved for staff review when locker code revocation cannot be confirmed. [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04]

No supplied evidence states how a partial batch return failure affects a hold assignment already triggered by an earlier successful return in the same batch. [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04][cd729138-dd10-4c76-b209-d2b44a4d104b]
No supplied evidence establishes the outcome of the next-quarter demand investigation for automatic third renewals and transferable family pickup codes. [3b39abb6-997d-48d8-a11e-da7b2bf6e923]

No supplied evidence states whether a cancelled hold's queue timestamp or sequence is retained for later assignment beyond the stated release of its queue position. [cd729138-dd10-4c76-b209-d2b44a4d104b]

knowledge.title: Exception handling and audit
gaps: The evidence does not specify what occurs after a librarian clears a damaged return for the next hold [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04].
The staff action or disposition after an item remains reserved for review when locker-code revocation cannot be confirmed is not specified [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04].
What happens after the 90-day audit retention period is not stated [922e733e-29b5-4bcd-b8db-38d8acd6b2d2].
Whether the release 6 exception rules apply beyond release 6 is not established by the supplied evidence [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04][922e733e-29b5-4bcd-b8db-38d8acd6b2d2].

knowledge.title: Deferred release decisions
gaps: No decision is recorded on the outcome of the next-quarter demand investigation or whether the deferred proposals will be revisited [3b39abb6-997d-48d8-a11e-da7b2bf6e923].
Approval status of the deferred proposals for any release other than release 6 is not established [3b39abb6-997d-48d8-a11e-da7b2bf6e923].
Whether the retained two-renewal limit and person-bound codes apply beyond this decision's stated scope is not specified [3b39abb6-997d-48d8-a11e-da7b2bf6e923].
The recorded non-approval does not state current behavior for suspended members and already-assigned locker holds [3b39abb6-997d-48d8-a11e-da7b2bf6e923].

knowledge.title: Loans and renewals
gaps: The deferred decision records demand investigation for automatic third renewals as next-quarter work with no approved follow-up, release target or outcome. [3b39abb6-997d-48d8-a11e-da7b2bf6e923]

The handbook states a lost item retains its loan until staff confirms replacement or recovery, but does not state what happens to active-loan counts or holds after that confirmation. [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04]
Renewal is barred when another member has an active hold; the evidence does not state whether the borrowing member's own hold on the same item affects renewal. [cd729138-dd10-4c76-b209-d2b44a4d104b]

The operating agreement gives circulation desk behavior for renewal and checkout, but does not state whether renewals for a suspended member are considered separately from the general suspension block. [cd729138-dd10-4c76-b209-d2b44a4d104b][922e733e-29b5-4bcd-b8db-38d8acd6b2d2]

knowledge.title: Returns and damage handling
gaps: The evidence does not establish whether a damaged return reduces the active-loan count, or how the loan and due date are treated while the item is in inspection pending a librarian's clearance. [cd729138-dd10-4c76-b209-d2b44a4d104b] [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04]

The evidence refers both to 'staff' who inspect damage before shelf/locker placement and to 'a librarian' who clears a damaged return, without establishing whether these are the same role or a handoff. [cd729138-dd10-4c76-b209-d2b44a4d104b] [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04]
How a cleared damaged return re-enters hold assignment or sorting, and what inspection records are kept, is not established. [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04]

The scope and follow-up of batch return failure handling (partial batch, retry behaviour, whether the failure is retried as one batch) is not established beyond the rule that successful earlier returns must not be erased. [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04]
No decision is recorded on how staff resolve or close daily reconciliation discrepancies beyond discrepancies being sent to staff. [113cdf43-46ec-4e9b-ab84-bdb1da0ddb04]

knowledge.title: Membership suspension and identity
gaps: No supplied evidence states what causes a membership suspension or how a suspension is lifted. [922e733e-29b5-4bcd-b8db-38d8acd6b2d2]
No supplied evidence describes how an identity mismatch is detected or what verification a desk librarian performs to resolve it. [922e733e-29b5-4bcd-b8db-38d8acd6b2d2]
No supplied evidence states whether suspension affects a member's ability to cancel a hold. [922e733e-29b5-4bcd-b8db-38d8acd6b2d2]

Whether suspended members may ever collect already-assigned locker holds has no supplied approval; the supplied suggestion was explicitly not approved and no alternative approval is provided. [3b39abb6-997d-48d8-a11e-da7b2bf6e923]

Whether automatic third renewals or transferable family pickup codes will be reconsidered is left open by the decision's direction to investigate demand next quarter. [3b39abb6-997d-48d8-a11e-da7b2bf6e923]
